note: This increment adds record-table and 64MiB boundary tests. The SymCache parser is unchanged.
covered: little-endian SYMC v7, v8 and v9 files use the 72-byte header DebugId and resolve by it rather than the binary name
version-specific record sizes and v7 u32 versus v8/v9 ULEB string lengths are parsed
v9 accepts no variable section or the current variable-header version 1 after extent checks and does not decode variable payloads
the 64MiB file limit and 1000000-entry limits for files, functions, source locations, ranges and strings are enforced
unsupported versions, malformed strings, invalid references, inline cycles, duplicate or unsorted ranges and truncated extents return no partial symbols
the final no-source-location sentinel ends the range tail and the innermost function is emitted without expanding inline parents
a positive source line and optional path are exposed as module-relative ranges
limits: No final image, public CI or external SDK crash was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
